name: fortigateaiassistant
title: Fortigate Ai Assistant
subTitle: FortiGate read-only assistant (agentic function-calling)
releaseNotes: v1.0.3 hotfix: (1) Settings localization — removed hard-coded Traditional Chinese connector-picker labels and linked settings states to the widget language. (2) Large firewall fleets — added an always-visible selection/health summary, auto-collapsed list above six devices, search, and a bounded responsive card grid. (3) Health sweep scaling — limited live probes to five concurrent requests and shortened long failure summaries. v1.0.3: (1) Answer quality — meta-prompts redesigned in canonical English with explicit final-answer rules (verdict-first line, evidence with policy IDs/counts, markdown table for 3+ items, single caveat line for unevaluated factors, one actionable recommendation) and the answer language is enforced from the widget language setting; all model-facing strings (tool descriptions, computed-tool notes, audit findings, errors) unified to English for multilingual consistency. (2) Trilingual UI (Korean/English/Chinese) — header language selector switches all labels, system messages and default favorite prompts instantly; custom favorites are preserved. (3) Startup health sweep — on widget launch every registered FortiGate is live-probed in parallel and a localized summary (healthy/down per firewall) is posted to the chat; probeHealth now returns a promise. v1.0.1 (correctness + performance): (1) Group-aware matching — check_connectivity / find_policies_by_ip now resolve address groups (upward transitive closure over nested groups, O(V+E) BFS) and service groups (recursive, cycle-safe) so policies referencing groups are matched correctly; fixes false BLOCKED / missed related_policies. (2) Per-question fetch memoization — identical (op,config,params) connector reads within one question share a single cached promise, deduplicating parallel and cross-round fetches. (3) Cross-round tool-call dedup in the agent loop — repeated identical function calls reuse prior results instead of re-executing, preserving MAX_ROUNDS budget. (4) audit_policies unused-address detection now uses downward group closure (addresses used only via groups are no longer flagged unused); exposure_scan resolves risky ports through service groups. Prior: Design system pass: CSS design tokens (colors/typography/radii as variables), semantic color separation (brand teal vs success-green vs user-indigo vs warn/danger), unified button system, keyboard focus rings on all controls, keyboard-accessible firewall cards. Chat now renders Markdown safely (bold/lists/tables/code/links, HTML-escaped + XSS-hardened) with per-message timestamp and copy button. Firewall cards compacted (single health line, hover-reveal refresh); example chips merged into editable Favorite prompts. Prior: fixed the chat area growing infinitely with no scroll: root now has max-height:96vh + overflow:hidden (bounds height even when the parent container is auto-height) and the messages list uses min-height:0 so it scrolls within that bound. Also: firewall status cards at the top (which firewalls are controlled: name/vdom/short config-id, click to switch active) with connector Health Status (native health_status from /api/integration/configuration/ + on-demand live probe) and editable Favorite prompt cards near the input (click to send, add/remove/edit). Plus full-height responsive chat layout, multi-firewall settings, and 6 read-only compute tools (check_connectivity, audit_policies, analyze_logs, exposure_scan, expand_group, compare_firewalls).

metadata.description: FortiGate read-only assistant. FortiAI (create_responses) selects read-only tools via function-calling; the widget executes them with filters through the FortiGate connector, trims/counts results client-side, and feeds only small summaries back — avoiding large-payload LLM failures.
